purpose: G2: at true BIKE L1 t=134 the DFR is unmeasurable; the measurable production signals are the convergence-iteration distribution and the never-tested negative direction (FRONEG, offsets [-1,0]).

design.pool: same archived L1 RAND pool, 32 keys (16 archived + 16 new)
design.errors: error ids 0..999, uniform weight 134, paired across arms
design.carrier: bf_parallel + classic threshold, max_iter=20 (the study carrier)

analysis: mean iterations, two-round and three-round convergence fractions
interpretation_rules: zero failures in an arm is reported as a bound, never as DFR=0
a FRONEG effect is only claimed if failures are observed; a null result is reported as 'no measurable harm at this sample size'
iteration-cost differences are the primary measurable production signal; they are reported with per-key spread, not only means
